title: Sistem Basis Data Relasional (Relational Database Management System)
lead: Menjelaskan konsep, arsitektur, dan komponen utama RDBMS. Mengevaluasi peran RDBMS dalam ekosistem data engineering modern (integritas, kinerja, skalabilitas).

sections.label: Relational Database Management System
sections.title: 1. Konsep & Arsitektur
body: RDBMS: data sebagai relasi + constraint (PK, FK, UNIQUE, CHECK) + ACID (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability). Komponen: parser/optimizer (rencana query), executor, storage engine (heap + B-tree index), buffer pool, WAL (write-ahead log), lock/concurrency manager (MVCC).
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: Elmasri & Navathe (2016) Ch.1-2, 17-19; Kleppmann (2017) Ch.7

sections.label: Relational Database Management System
sections.title: 2. Integritas & Kinerja
body: Normalisasi (Modul 8) menjaga integritas; index B-tree mempercepat lookup/filter/join tapi memperlambat write. EXPLAIN ANALYZE untuk membaca query plan. Isolasi transaksi: read committed vs repeatable read vs serializable — tradeoff konsistensi vs throughput.

sections.label: Relational Database Management System
sections.title: 3. Peran Modern + Tugas-1
body: RDBMS tetap jadi system of record OLTP; analitik berat di-offload ke warehouse/lakehouse via CDC. Justifikasi pemilihan: butuh join kompleks + ACID kuat → RDBMS (PostgreSQL); butuh skala tulis masif/skema fleksibel → NoSQL (Modul 11). TUGAS-1: Analisis & Visualisasi Data (dataset pilihan, EDA + dashboard, dinilai di Mg 7).
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: ACID, MVCC, B-tree index, WAL, Query plan, CDC

sections.label: Implementasi Praktis
sections.title: Contoh Kode & Query
body: Berikut adalah contoh kode atau kueri terkait topik modul ini:
sections.callout:
-- Index + lihat query plan
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_date ON orders(customer_id, order_date);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = 42 AND order_date >= '2025-01-01';

quiz.question: Struktur indeks default kebanyakan RDBMS…
quiz.explanation: B-tree: seimbang untuk range + point lookup.

quiz.question: WAL (Write-Ahead Log) menjamin…
quiz.explanation: Tulis log dulu sebelum data page → bisa recovery.

quiz.question: Perintah untuk melihat rencana eksekusi query…
quiz.explanation: Rencana: seq scan vs index scan, cost, rows.

quiz.question: Isolasi tertinggi (paling konsisten, paling lambat)…
quiz.explanation: Serializable mencegah anomaly konkurensi dengan harga throughput.
